$uid..validate: newData.hasChildren(['uid', 'name', 'platform', 'online', 'joinedAt', 'lastSeen']) && newData.child('uid').val() === auth.uid && newData.child('name').isString() && newData.child('platform').val() === 'android' && newData.child('online').isBoolean() && newData.child('joinedAt').isNumber() && newData.child('lastSeen').isNumber()

$triggerId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['from', 'fromName', 'pattern', 'createdAt']) && newData.child('from').val() === auth.uid && newData.child('fromName').isString() && newData.child('pattern').isString() && newData.child('pattern').val().matches(/^(tap|double|snap|knock|wave|heartbeat|pendulum|ripple|crescendo|rain|sonar|shiver|sos|long|custom)$/) && newData.child('createdAt').isNumber() && (!newData.child('meaning').exists() || (newData.child('meaning').isString() && newData.child('meaning').val().matches(/^.{1,32}$/)))

$commandId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['from', 'fromName', 'kind', 'torch', 'createdAt']) && newData.child('from').val() === auth.uid && newData.child('fromName').isString() && newData.child('kind').val() === 'torch' && newData.child('torch').isBoolean() && newData.child('createdAt').isNumber()

$shareId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['from', 'fromName', 'label', 'timings', 'createdAt']) && newData.child('from').isString() && newData.child('fromName').isString() && newData.child('label').isString() && newData.child('label').val().matches(/^.{1,24}$/) && newData.child('timings').exists() && newData.child('createdAt').isNumber()
